# Weight

<!-- STEP id="g" -->
A falling object speeds up with an acceleration g = 9.8 m/s². For quick estimates, we can take g = 10 m/s². The value of g does not depend on the mass of the object.

<!-- STEP id="mg" -->
The force with which the Earth pulls an object is its weight. From F = ma, the weight of an object of mass m is F = mg. A 1 kg mass has a weight of 9.8 N.
